# Delivery schedule

## Regulatory clearance and new M0 authority / M0-M0

Dependency: Written restart permission and sponsor authorization

Output: Clock starts; unknown preceding hold is not forecast

Status: Blocked by external confirmation

## Land, survey and constraints / M0-M6

Dependency: Access permission and seller cooperation

Output: Option/title/survey/ESA/geotechnical and legal-use decision

Status: Planned

## Grid intake, dynamic models and batch/studies / M0-M18

Dependency: Available post-hold intake; site and financial evidence

Output: Allocated pathway, cost and staged connection terms

Status: Conditional; no queue position

## Customer requirements and anchor contracting / M2-M18

Dependency: Site/power diligence and product specification

Output: Credit-supported 50 MW anchor and phase options

Status: Planned; no interest verified

## Design, water, air and land-use approvals / M2-M18

Dependency: Survey, utility studies and regulator acceptance

Output: 30% design then permit-ready issued design

Status: Planned

## HV tender and technical freeze / M3-M12

Dependency: Preliminary TSP interface, fault duty, site access and supplier quotations

Output: Reviewed RFQ, bankable manufacturing slot, interfaces and sponsor-approved cancellation exposure

Status: Planned; no supplier slot

## HV equipment release and manufacture / M12-M42

Dependency: Separate sponsor approval for pre-FID order; utility design sufficiently mature; permit conditions and cancel/change exposure accepted

Output: 30-month order-to-site window including factory witness tests, freight and all 4 primary transformers delivered by M42

Status: Conditional; no order or quote

## HV install and site acceptance / M42-M46

Dependency: Foundations and cable routes ready, compliant delivery, utility works and authorized installation

Output: Installed primary equipment, SAT, calibrated metering, relay and telemetry evidence

Status: Conditional

## Phase 1 integrated commissioning and handover / M46-M48

Dependency: Utility/ERCOT energization approval, complete cooling/UPS/standby and tenant acceptance criteria

Output: Witnessed capacity/thermal/failure tests and signed 25 MW acceptance

Status: Conditional; no approved test plan

## FID and construction debt close / M18-M18

Dependency: Permits, power contract, prelease, EPC scope and downside model

Output: Authorized notice to proceed and funded contingency

Status: Unmet

## Enabling works and campus utilities / M18-M28

Dependency: FID and construction stormwater coverage

Output: Graded pads, drainage, roads, fiber ducts and backbone

Status: Planned

## Phase 1 build, energize and commission / M24-M48

Dependency: Equipment, utility completion and explicit energization permission

Output: 25 MW IT accepted at M48 after factory delivery, site testing and explicit energization permission

Status: Conditional date

## Phase 2 delivery / M30-M54

Dependency: Lease and reserved capacity ramp

Output: 50 MW cumulative IT accepted at M54

Status: Conditional date

## Phase 3 delivery / M36-M60

Dependency: Lease and reserved capacity ramp

Output: 75 MW cumulative IT accepted at M60

Status: Conditional date

## Phase 4 delivery / M42-M66

Dependency: Lease and reserved capacity ramp

Output: 100 MW cumulative IT accepted at M66

Status: Conditional date

## Operations, warranty and compliance / M48-M78

Dependency: Phase handover and trained operations staff

Output: SLA reporting, water/emissions records and maintenance program
